exposure: indications for obstetric hysterectomy (e.g., morbidly adherent placenta, postpartum hemorrhage)
outcome: characteristics of patients undergoing obstetric hysterectomy
cohort: Patients who underwent obstetric hysterectomy among 8881 deliveries at C.U.Shah Medical College and Hospital from January 2018 to December 2020.
finding: The study found an incidence of 0.2% for obstetric hysterectomy among 8881 deliveries, with maximum patients aged 31-35 years, 70% from lower middle class, and an increasing trend linked to cesarean deliveries and morbidly adherent placenta.
mod_finding: Obstetric hysterectomy was required in 9 out of 6871 (0.13%) vaginal deliveries and 11 out of 2510 (0.44%) cesarean deliveries.
